name: apiforge-monorepo
description: APIFORGE — Test smarter. Ship with confidence. Open-source API testing, validation, performance and security analysis platform.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @apiforge/engine run build && pnpm --filter ./packages/cli run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @apiforge/engine run build && pnpm --filter @apiforge/engine run typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/cli run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/run-examples.mjs
